response: ["The licensed guideline corpus contains no recommendation for 'NEV'.","The 7-point checklist score indicates melanoma suspicion.","The router retrieves guidance under the melanoma condition (MEL).","Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended first-line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.","Surgical margins for excision should be based on tumor thickness.","Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor when indicated, and in the same operative setting whenever possible.","When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.","Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as facial lentigo maligna, acral lesions, and genital lesions.","The 7-point score is driven by the presence of a blue‑whitish veil (+2 points), localized irregular pigmentation (+1 point), and irregular dots and globules (+1 point).","These features are considered minor or major criteria that contribute to melanoma suspicion.","The image should be examined for a blue‑whitish veil, which is confluent blue pigment with an overlying white haze.","The image should also be examined for irregular pigmentation (asymmetric blotches) and irregular dots and globules (varied size and uneven distribution)."]
